description: Meta Ad Library API: Search ads. Ads matching a keyword or an advertiser page, with filters, up to 30 per call. Every ad carries days_active (whole days from started_at to ended_at, or to today while it runs; null when unknown) and winning_score (0-100, null when days_active is null): long-running ads are the ones that pay off. score = L + V + R, with L = 70 x min(days_active, 90) / 90, V = 15 x min(variants_count - 1, 9) / 9 and R = 15 x min(log10(1 + EU reach) / 6, 1). The EU reach is only in the single-ad lookup, so in lists score = (L + V) x 100 / 85: a missing reach never lowers it. Rounded to the nearest integer. min_days_active and sort=longevity apply to the ads of the returned page, at the same price. Price: 5 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call). One of q, page_id is required.

limit.description: Ads per page (max 30, one page of the source)

min_days_active.description: Keep only ads running for at least this many days (applied to the returned page, same price)

page_id.description: Only ads of this advertiser page

sort.description: Order. `longevity` puts the longest-running ads of the page first.

name: ads_ads_search
title: Search ads
